characteristic_features: autoimmune / paraneoplastic features (hypergammaglobulinaemia, positive Coombs, cytopenias)

biomarkers.name: TFH markers (CD10, BCL6, PD1, CXCL13, ICOS)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Expression of TFH phenotype markers supports diagnosis; WHO/ICC frameworks recognize nodal TFH-cell lymphomas including angioimmunoblastic type, generally requiring TFH-marker expression by the neoplastic T cells rather than a single pathognomonic marker set. Renamed 'nodal TFH-cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic-type' in WHO 2022

biomarkers.name: TET2 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Very common; often co-occurs with DNMT3A and/or RHOA. Also seen in age-related clonal haematopoiesis in the same patients

biomarkers.name: IDH2 R172 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Highly characteristic of AITL/nodal TFH-cell lymphoma among lymphomas. Potential enasidenib trials

biomarkers.name: RHOA G17V mutation
biomarkers.clinical_use: Highly characteristic of AITL and other nodal TFH-cell lymphomas, especially follicular-type TFH lymphoma

biomarkers.name: EBV+ B cells (expanded)
biomarkers.clinical_use: EBV-driven B-cell expansion in AITL microenvironment; occasional composite or secondary EBV+ B-cell lymphoma including DLBCL

biomarkers.name: 5-azacitidine, romidepsin (epigenetic therapy)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Responses have been reported in relapsed/refractory TFH-type PTCL/AITL, providing biologic rationale related to recurrent epigenetic mutations, but this is not a validated biomarker-based standard predictive marker

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Polymorphic infiltrate with proliferation of high endothelial venules and expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks; neoplastic TFH-derived T cells scattered within

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Distinctive polymorphic TME with expanded EBV+ B-cell component driven by neoplastic TFH cells — occasional composite or secondary EBV+ B-cell lymphoma including DLBCL; autoimmune paraneoplastic features common (hypergammaglobulinaemia, positive Coombs)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Proliferation of high endothelial venules (HEVs) and expanded FDC meshworks characteristic; polymorphic inflammatory background

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Follicular helper T (TFH) cells — specialised CD4+ T cells that help germinal centre B-cell responses
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: TFH differentiation with characteristic markers (CD10+, PD-1/CD279+, ICOS+, CXCL13+, BCL6+, CD40L+) recapitulating normal TFH biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Distinctive epigenetic dysregulation biology: TET2, DNMT3A, IDH2 R172 mutations affect DNA methylation; RHOA G17V mutation is highly characteristic; combined mutations drive TFH-like phenotype; polymorphic TME with expanded EBV+ B-cell component and follicular dendritic cell meshworks
